name: Provider page shell
summary: The provider's own page: a skip link, a header with the provider and “Atmosphere provider”, the main content, and the reassuring footer.

when: For every provider page: signing in, signing up, codes and Connect.

anatomy.description: The provider's badge, and the mark with “Atmosphere provider”.
The page's content, usually a card.
“This is [provider]'s own page. [provider] hosts your Atmosphere account, and [app] never sees your password.”

props.name: provider
props.description: The provider: a known provider's id, or its name.

props.name: appName
props.description: The app the person came from, for the footer.

accessibility.role: main, with header and footer landmarks
accessibility.name: None.

keyboard.action: The first Tab shows the skip link.

screenReader: Landmarks for the header, main and footer, so people can jump between them.
notes: The main landmark has an id, so the skip link can move focus to it.
The skip link opens the banner, so it's the first Tab stop and, like everything else on the page, inside a landmark.

guidelines: The footer always says the app never sees the password.

dosAndDonts.do: Name the provider in the header and footer.
dosAndDonts.dont: Show the app's branding on the provider's page.

evidence.point: Saying the app never sees the password builds trust at the moment people type it (prototype research).
